entities.summary: Gaozu, a notable figure in the history of Mongolia, associated with Xiongnu Empire (209 BCE–60 BCE). Preceded by Han dynasty begins heqin policy — sending princesses and tribute to the Xiongnu. Their legacy influenced Modu Chanyu unifies the steppe and defeats Han Emperor Gaozu at Baideng and Han-Xiongnu Wars and Decline.
